I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. That's from Tobias's Oct 14 post in the same channel, and Hollis is a member there, so he could already see it.

I couldn't check the number against anything else, because I found no Marrow contract or account files I can read. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so it was fine to share with the Central team.
